headline.head: $503 WHEN THE NEXT BID WAS $400
headline.sub: Vladimir Tuten went $103 clear of the field for James Cook. Only the winner pays, and the winner paid.

paper.obituary: Lowest score. No appeal. No mercy.

jokes.text: Cook did return 20.9 points, so at least the overkill wasn't wasted, just unnecessary.
That's about $27 a point. There are worse ways to light FAAB on fire, but not many.

jokes.premise: scored from the bench out of spite
jokes.text: He scored 8.4 anyway, from the bench, presumably out of spite.
elifelber, 65.7 points, lowest in the league. Eliminated. No appeal, no mercy.
